grammar_concept.title: Past Continuous: was/were + verb-ing
grammar_concept.rule: Use the Past Continuous (was/were + verb-ing) for an action in progress at a specific past moment, often interrupted by another, shorter action (in Past Simple).
grammar_concept.simple_explanation: Descreve algo que estava a acontecer, em curso, num momento específico do passado — muitas vezes interrompido por outra coisa.
grammar_concept.example: I was cooking dinner when the phone rang. They were watching TV all evening.
grammar_concept.example_translation: Eu estava a cozinhar o jantar quando o telefone tocou. Eles estiveram a ver televisão a noite toda.
grammar_concept.common_mistake_pt: Falantes de português tendem a usar o Past Simple para as duas ações, sem distinguir a ação em curso (interrompida) da ação que interrompe: dizem "I cooked dinner when the phone rang" em vez de "I was cooking dinner when the phone rang". A ação de fundo, mais longa, pede Past Continuous; a ação pontual que a interrompe pede Past Simple.
grammar_concept.correction: Ação em curso, interrompida → was/were + verbo-ing ("I was cooking..."). Ação pontual que interrompe → Past Simple ("...when the phone rang"). As duas partes normalmente aparecem juntas, ligadas por "when" ou "while".
grammar_concept.real_world_example: A contar uma história: "I was walking home when I saw an old friend."

vocabulary.definition_en: to stop someone while they are doing something, by suddenly doing or saying something
example_sentences: Sorry to interrupt, but you have a phone call.

vocabulary.definition_en: at the same time, while something else is happening
example_sentences: I was cooking. Meanwhile, my son was doing his homework.
I was walking home when it suddenly started to rain.

exercises.prompt: Complete: I ___ (cook) dinner when the phone rang.
exercises.explanation: Ação em curso no passado, interrompida → Past Continuous ("was cooking").
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Usar o Past Simple ("cooked") aqui é um erro comum, perdendo a ideia de que a ação estava em curso.

correct_answer: They were watching a film when the power went out.
distractors: They watched a film when the power was going out.
They were watching a film when the power was going out.
They watch a film when the power went out.
exercises.explanation: A ação de fundo (assistir ao filme) leva Past Continuous; a ação pontual que interrompe (a luz falhar) leva Past Simple.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Colocar as duas ações no Past Continuous é um erro comum — só a ação de fundo leva essa forma.

correct_answer: at the same time, while something else is happening
exercises.explanation: "Meanwhile" liga duas ações que acontecem ao mesmo tempo.

exercises.prompt: Listen to the audio. What was the speaker doing when someone knocked?
exercises.explanation: No áudio, ouve-se: "I was reading a book when someone suddenly knocked on the door."
exercises.transcript: I was reading a book when someone suddenly knocked on the door. Meanwhile, my sister was sleeping in the next room.

exercises.prompt: Read the text: "Yesterday at 8pm, I was having dinner with friends. Meanwhile, my neighbour was moving furniture into her new flat — I could hear it through the wall." What was the neighbour doing at 8pm?
exercises.explanation: O texto indica diretamente: "my neighbour was moving furniture".

exercises.prompt: Translate to English: "Eu estava a dormir quando o meu telemóvel tocou de repente."
correct_answer: I was sleeping when my phone suddenly rang.
I was sleeping when my phone rang suddenly.
exercises.explanation: "Estava a dormir" corresponde ao Past Continuous ("was sleeping"), não ao Past Simple.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Usar "I slept" em vez de "I was sleeping" é o erro mais comum nesta frase — perde-se a ideia de que o sono já estava em curso.

steps.content: In the middle of a sentence, "was"/"were" are usually weak and unstressed: "was" → /wəz/ ("I was cooking" sounds like "I wz cooking"). In a short answer like "Yes, I was", it's pronounced fully and clearly: /wɒz/.

steps.prompt: Tell a short story about something that interrupted you while you were doing another activity.
Write 5 sentences about what you and people you know were doing at specific past moments, using the Past Continuous.
